description: This file contains a Spark Streaming example for a recoverable network word count application. It includes singleton objects for broadcast variables and accumulators, and the main object sets up a streaming context that reads from a socket, counts words, and handles checkpointing and recovery.

classes.name: WordExcludeList
classes.description: Singleton object providing a broadcast variable for a list of words to exclude from counting.

classes.name: DroppedWordsCounter
classes.description: Singleton object providing a LongAccumulator to count dropped words.

classes.name: RecoverableNetworkWordCount
classes.description: Main object that sets up and runs the recoverable network word count streaming application.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the broadcast variable or accumulator, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates and configures a new StreamingContext with socket stream, word count, checkpointing, and recovery logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses arguments, manages checkpointing, and starts the streaming context.
